# Loading

Loading indicator: a centered spinner. Pages with a known layout should use PageSkeleton instead; use this one
only for short, local loading.

**Interaction**: stays invisible after mounting and fades in after 200 ms, so loads that finish quickly do not
flash an indicator; "stay visible for at least 400 ms once shown" is controlled with useDelayedPending. Not
interactive; screen readers announce "Loading".

**Category**: Feedback · **Common uses**: Short loading inside drawers, dialogs and panels

## Import

```ts
import { Loading } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Short loads inside a drawer or panel. After mounting it stays invisible and fades in only after 200 ms.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return <Loading />
}
```

## Advanced

### Keeping old data while refreshing

The old content stays in place during a refresh, and useDelayedPending controls the loading indicator: it appears
only after 200 ms and then stays for at least 400 ms. The indicator is mounted only while the hook returns true,
so pass `immediate` to avoid a second delay.

```tsx
export function Refreshing() {
  const [fetching, setFetching] = useState(false)
  const showLoading = useDelayedPending(fetching)
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Button
        onClick={() => {
          setFetching(true)
          setTimeout(() => setFetching(false), 900)
        }}
      >
        Refresh
      </Button>
      <Text>12 new files this week</Text>
      {showLoading && <Loading immediate />}
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | Text for screen readers and the tooltip, "Loading" by default. | — | No |
| `fill` | `boolean` | Fills the height of the parent and centers the indicator (loading a whole area). | — | No |
| `immediate` | `boolean` | Shows the indicator immediately, without the 200 ms delayed appearance. Only use it when the indicator is controlled by useDelayedPending and mounted only while that is true, so the delay is not applied twice (for example when old data stays visible during a refresh, with the indicator on top of it). | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
